dominant_themes: fraternity and national unity (dignity of individual, unity and integrity)
scope_boundary: This chapter focuses exclusively on the Preamble of the Indian Constitution: its text, ingredients, key words, significance, legal status, and amenability. It references related constitutional provisions (Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles) and judicial interpretations (Kesavananda Bharati, Berubari Union) only to elucidate the Preamble. Detailed analysis of other constitutional articles or foreign constitutions beyond comparative mentions is out of scope.

natural_clusters.label: Text and Ingredients
members: Source of authority (the people of India)
Nature of Indian State (sovereign socialist secular democratic republic)
Objectives of the Constitution (justice, liberty, equality, fraternity)

natural_clusters.label: Significance of the Preamble
members: Horoscope of our sovereign democratic republic (Munshi)

natural_clusters.label: Preamble as Part of the Constitution
members: Berubari Union case (1960) — Preamble not part of Constitution
Kesavananda Bharati case (1973) — Preamble is part of Constitution
LIC of India case (1995) — Preamble is integral part

natural_clusters.label: Amenability of the Preamble
members: 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act (1976) — added Socialist, Secular, Integrity
Basic structure doctrine — cannot alter fundamental features in Preamble
